visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a modern gym with dark grey walls and various weight-lifting machines. A muscular man, acting as a coach, stands with his left foot resting on a weight bench. He wears a black t-shirt featuring a bodybuilder graphic and olive green pants, with prominent tattoos on his arms. On the bench, another man in a white tank top and black shorts is performing bench presses with a barbell. The coach is humorously holding a yellow banana to his ear as if it were a telephone while looking down at the trainee. (2) As the trainee continues his repetitions, the coach engages in a comedic conversation, pointing towards someone off-camera. A third young man in a white t-shirt briefly walks into the frame from the right side. The background shows other gym members and weight plates on racks. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional fitness facility. (3) The coach concludes his phone call on the banana, looking around the gym while the trainee finishes his set and rests on the bench. The camera remains static, capturing the full interaction between the two main individuals. The overall atmosphere is lighthearted and comedic, contrasted by the serious gym environment and equipment.

By using a banana as a phone and discussing food orders mid-exercise, the creators aim to entertain fitness enthusiasts with relatable yet absurd humor.
